title: Why does an airplane window have a tiny hole?
chunks: the air outside is too thin to breathe,
so the cabin air is pressurized.

beats.hole: Mia points at the tiny dot in the window
beats.mistake: Otto's face goes red and steams
beats.cruising: the plane flies high above the clouds
beats.thin: Otto floats outside, gasping, face pale blue
beats.pressurized: dense air dots inside the wall, sparse outside
beats.drilled: the drill bit enters the middle pane
beats.gap: air dots flow through the hole into the gap
beats.load: the outer pane glows orange under the load
beats.moisture: blue droplets drift out through the hole
beats.fog: fog layer fades off the glass
